name: pageree
description: Pageree lets your AI assistant publish landing pages that collect leads, then read how visitors behave and improve each page with you.

interface.longDescription:
Pageree lets your assistant take a page all the way to a result: live on a real URL, collecting leads, and improving from how visitors behave.

Describe the offer and the assistant builds the page, shows you a private preview, and publishes it when you approve. Forms are validated, spam is held back, every lead is kept, and each one is delivered to your email, a webhook or your CRM. Connect your own domain and the certificate is handled for you.

Once visitors arrive, ask how the page is doing. The assistant reads traffic, sources and section-by-section behaviour, makes one focused change, republishes, and compares the versions. Every publish is a version you can roll back.
defaultPrompt: Build a landing page for my bakery's wedding-cake tastings, with a form that sends each booking request to my email.
How is my landing page doing this week, and what should I change?
My page gets visitors but nobody signs up. Look at the analytics and fix the weakest part.
